title: In history mode a self-billed work order shows no Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself, with at least one earlier version in its history.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open work order 1 in history mode.
  3. Expand the Customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The work order shows in history mode.

Step 3:

  • The Customer card shows Authorizer.
  • No "Bill To" field shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
